name: Omapaper
author: Iuri
description: Browse, cycle, and set backgrounds from every Omarchy theme, not just the active one

barWidget.description: Left-click browses every theme's wallpapers, middle-click steps to the next, right-click opens settings.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut
schema.description: Global shortcut that opens the picker. Set it to nothing to run with no shortcut. If the combination is already bound to something else, Omapaper leaves it alone and says so.

schema.label: Extra wallpaper folder
schema.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) to one more folder of wallpapers to load alongside the themes'. Leave empty for none.
